svg.desc: Sequential text excerpt containing the title, 20 July 2017 Recommendation status, and opening abstract sentences of the official W3C SHACL specification.
svg.text: This document defines the SHACL Shapes
Constraint Language, a language for validating
RDF graphs against a set of conditions. These
conditions are provided as shapes and other
constructs expressed in the form of an RDF
